subject: ddl: make args/DecodeArgs un-exported (#56687)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff (vs parent a00ba68b...) and minimal surrounding callers in `pkg/ddl` and `pkg/meta/model`. Change is a refactor that makes `model.Job`/`SubJob` decoded-args caches and `DecodeArgs` helper unexported (`args`/`decodeArgs`), adds `Job.ClearDecodedArgs()` and `SubJob.FillArgs/Clone()`, and updates DDL job submission + multi-schema handling accordingly (plus removes the test-only failpoint that corrupted `job.Args`). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, metadata persistence/encoding, multi-schema state-machine handling, or add-index/DXF-related job propagation.
